dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent 'O'-shaped structures are visible along the dorsal midline, characterized by jagged, high-frequency perimeter edges with a sharp gradient transition from light gray exterior boundaries to dark, low-intensity interior cores. One 'C'-shaped structure is observed towards the posterior with the opening oriented caudally.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of solid high-intensity white pixel clusters is concentrated along the ventral-lateral transition. These clusters lack internal gradients and form a nearly continuous high-luminance band at the lower edge of the visible body. Sparse, isolated low-intensity dark blobs are distributed within the lighter patterned regions near the anterior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three primary dorsal annuli form an obtuse triangular formation with the vertex located at the largest mid-dorsal structure. A secondary linear sequence of keypoints is formed by a series of four smaller, closely packed blobs near the nuchal region.

other_distinctive_markers: A series of distinct, parallel high-contrast transverse bands of light-colored pixels are visible around the neck, creating a ringed or segmented visual effect separate from the primary dorsal pattern.
